sources: https://huggingface.co/api/models?author=<org>&sort=createdAt&limit=25 for 31 publishers incl. every family already in machines.json

rules.latest: upstream (original-publisher) instruct/chat text LLM created 2026-08-24..2026-11-22 (90 days), >=3B params, likes>=150 or 30-day downloads>=100k
rules.popular: upstream instruct text LLM created >=2025-07, older than 90 days, likes>=1000 or 30-day downloads>=300k; a family slot is taken by its newest version
rules.suitability: runnable through a catalogue engine (llama.cpp, MLX, Strata, ds4, vLLM) and plausibly a coding agent; tool-call probe and published coding scores are NOT yet collected (round 1+)
rules.coverage: covered = a measured row of the SAME upstream model (any quantisation of its weights) on a machine it fits, or an explicit does-not-fit row; a derivative fine-tune row does not cover its base; a catalogue-only row with no engine (modes []) is not a does-not-fit claim and does not count

excluded.why: superseded by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (same family and size)
superseded by Qwen3.5-4B / Qwen3.5-9B / Qwen3.8-27B; their catalogue rows stay published

excluded.what: zai-org/GLM-4.5-Air, poolside/Laguna-XS.2, ornith Ornith-1.0, JetBrains Mellum2
excluded.why: superseded by a newer version of the same family
base model only, no instruct release
scientific multimodal models, not coding-agent models (Sage-S2.1-Flash keeps its catalogue row)
under 3B parameters (Raon-1-nano: size not verified, excluded by its name)

excluded.what: derivative fine-tunes and re-quantisations (base_model points at another publisher): Edge0-145B, NousResearch/Arete-27B, ConwayResearch/Underdog-Saluki-27B, RadixArk/DaisyRose-27B, Cloudflare/clef, prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B, nvidia Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B, XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B, harness-hub adapters, all uncensored/abliterated/heretic uploads, and catalogue derivatives (Inkling-2-Mini-Uncensored, Qwen3.5-9B Defiant, DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-4B, Apex-35B, Muse Glimmer 30B)
excluded.why: the candidate is the upstream release; a derivative row never covers its base. Derivative rows stay published outside the KPI

excluded.what: TTS, ASR, OCR, image, video and embedding models

fit_rule.formula: (weights + f16 KV at 32,768 tokens) x 1.1 <= box memory; formats gated per box (a2: only w8a8 via vLLM-Ascend or q4_0 via llama.cpp CANN; Macs/gb10/amd395: GGUF/MLX)
fit_rule.m4mini_note: m4mini uses its Metal working set, not its 16 GB: recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize reads 12,713 MB (llama.cpp, 2026-11-22) and Strata reports workSet 11.8 GiB; 11.4 GB decimal is used, consistent with the 14.5 GB MiniCPM-V file running hybrid there. This is the round-0 harness edit.
caveats: weights are params x bpw / 8 from the HF safetensors total, an ESTIMATE; a measured file size in machines.json always wins (DeepSeek-V4-Flash: 87 GB measured vs 105 GB estimated at Q2_K_XL)

models whose exports stream a table from disk (DeepSeek-V4.1 engram/n-gram, Qwen3.8 MTP per-layer embedding) run resident with less than their file size; the estimate does not model that, which is why V4.1-Flash-1017 shows a2-only while it is measured on m1u and amd395
KV for Inkling-2-Mini counts all 48 loop visits at full attention, an upper bound: its 1,024-token sliding window is not in config.json
linear-attention / SSM layers carry constant state and are ignored

C_baseline.measured_from: machines.json at 9286bf4 (rows existing before this round)

C_after_round0.change: Inkling-2-Mini base measured on m4mini and m1u (llama.cpp), 2026-11-22, by user instruction
